_comment: The pinned cloud-sdk image every non-backend Cloud Build step uses, as its registry config records it (read 2026-11-20 from gcr.io: manifest -> config blob; no image was run). Re-record this file when the pin changes. 'present' lists only what the image's own build proves: bash from the Debian base it names, gcloud via `gcloud-crc32c /usr/bin/gcloud`, and gcloud's Python via `test "$GCLOUD_PYTHON" = /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/platform/bundledpythonunix/bin/python3`. 'absent_on_path' is what that build asserts is NOT on PATH (`! command -v python3`).
